summary: This is a Makefile snippet that defines a 'clean' target to remove build artifacts and temporary files from a project. When you run 'make clean', it deletes node_modules and vendor directories, then empties cache and log directories, with yellow colored status messages printed along the way.

explanations.1: This defines a variable COLOR_YELLOW and sets it to the ANSI escape code 33, which tells the terminal to print text in yellow.
explanations.4: The @printf command prints a message to the terminal without echoing the command itself (that's what @ does); the \e[1;${COLOR_YELLOW}m part makes the text bold and yellow, and \e[0m resets the formatting back to normal.
explanations.5: This removes the node_modules and vendor directories completely using rm with --recursive (delete folders and contents) and --force (don't ask for confirmation).
explanations.7: This deletes all files inside the .cache, .output, and storage/logs directories using the /* wildcard, which matches everything inside those folders but preserves the folders themselves.
